title: Can GPT-6 Astra Build a Spoiler Blocker?
description: I gave GPT-6 Astra one shot to build a browser extension that blocks selected spoiler terms, then tested the real output on an original mock feed. It worked—but the false positive and missed oblique spoiler show exactly why keyword blocking is useful, not magical. #GPT6 #Astra #AI #shorts
